text: Binance Attacker Moved About $242 Million via Tron Within Two Days; Over $3 Billion in Stolen Assets Remain Largely Untouched According to on-chain analyst SomaXBT, about two days after the Binance attack, the attacker transferred approximately $242 million through Tron-related paths. In the incident, roughly $628 million in assets on Tron were stolen. After Tether froze about 378.7 million USDT, the attacker moved funds via Relay, THORChain, Chainflip, Symbiosis and other channels. An additional approximately $41.7 million flowed through Bitget Wallet, with its destination still unconfirmed. About $7.5 million remains on Tron, while more than $3 billion in stolen assets held by the attacker on other chains have largely remained unmoved. — link
